=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: §20 (CHANGELOG Entries, MANDATORY) requires the changelog fragment to faithfully describe the behaviour shipped by the PR, including the cases in which an operator must perform manual setup.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/6712-propagate-consumer-secrets-schedule.md, line 4.
  Evidence of absence: line 4 of the fragment reads "/seed-repo now treats the registration and its propagation run as the normal way consumers get their secrets, and asks for manual setup only after a failed run or a `no-register` seed." This same PR updates .claude/commands/seed-repo.md lines 22, 26 and 49, workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md lines 22, 26 and 49, and README.md lines 52-53 to add `status=skipped_empty` (the library secret is unset) as a third case for manual setup. The script (scripts/propagate_consumer_secrets.sh:174-177) emits `status=skipped_empty` and the run exits green, so an operator reading only the changelog will be told manual setup is unnecessary in the case the implementation (and the updated README/seed-repo) actually require it.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
